blogs.title: Not All Swollen Necks Are Angioedema: Spotting Dermatomyositis in the ED
blogs.description: Walk through an approach to atraumatic neck swelling that distinguishes histamine/bradykinin angioedema and deep neck space infection from inflammatory myopathy–related pseudoangioedema. Practical pearls: when to order a creatine kinase, subtle cutaneous and nailfold clues worth hunting for, interpretation of normal C4/C1-inhibitor testing, and imaging hints (strap muscle edema without abscess). Includes a rapid bedside algorithm and consult triggers for ENT, immunology, and rheumatology.

blogs.title: Airway at Risk: Dysphagia and Extrathoracic Restriction in Dermatomyositis
blogs.description: Focus on upper aerodigestive involvement in inflammatory myopathies: recognizing severe pharyngeal dysphagia, microaspiration patterns on CT, and extrathoracic restrictive PFTs. Discuss early nasendoscopy and videofluoroscopy, aspiration mitigation, nasogastric feeding, and when to escalate to pulse steroids and IVIG for airway/ swallowing muscle compromise. Practical coordination between ENT, speech therapy, and the admitting team.

blogs.title: Decoding Anti-SAE1 Dermatomyositis: Phenotype, Pitfalls, and Cancer Risk
blogs.description: Translate the significance of an anti-SAE1 result at the bedside. Review its cutaneous phenotype, frequent dysphagia and ILD, and how it compares with MDA5 and TIF1-γ. Outline how to use myositis panels judiciously and apply IMACS cancer-screening risk stratification (why SAE1, male sex, DM phenotype, and dysphagia push risk higher). Provide a stepwise malignancy workup and surveillance plan that balances yield and radiation.

blogs.title: Imaging and Biopsy Strategy in Suspected Inflammatory Myopathy
blogs.description: How to leverage MRI and FDG-PET to map disease activity, guide biopsy site selection, and screen for malignancy in one coordinated pathway. Interpret muscle MRI edema patterns, recognize PET pitfalls, and correlate pathology hallmarks of dermatomyositis (perifascicular injury and C5b-9 deposition) versus immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy and polymyositis. Practical tips to avoid a nondiagnostic biopsy.

blogs.title: Therapeutic Blitz for Severe Dermatomyositis: Choosing and Sequencing Agents
blogs.description: Rationalize early combination therapy for severe oropharyngeal involvement: pulse methylprednisolone, IVIG induction/maintenance, and steroid-sparing immunosuppression (why mycophenolate over methotrexate with lung concerns; where rituximab fits). Include monitoring, tapering strategies, and PJP prophylaxis options when TMP-SMX is not tolerated (e.g., inhaled pentamidine). Brief evidence snapshot and practical dosing pearls.

blogs.title: When ‘Hepatitis’ Is Muscle: Interpreting AST/ALT in Myositis
blogs.description: Clarify the lab pattern of active myositis—very high CK with AST>ALT and elevated LDH—and how to avoid unnecessary hepatic workups. Offer a concise approach to transaminase elevation in the dyspneic or weak patient, integrating CK, urinalysis for myoglobin, viral hepatitis screening before immunosuppression, and serial trends to document treatment response.
